title: Nothing offers a full look at its AI earbuds and charging case
slides: Nothing's new earbuds: what is it hiding?
It calls them the Ear (1) with ANC
But the case doubles as a battery bank
You can top up your phone from the case
Check if your phone supports reverse charging
thread_text:
1. Earbuds or power bank?

The Nothing Ear (1) hides a feature that turns its case into a backup battery for your phone. Here's what that means for your daily carry.

2. ANC without the price tag

Active noise cancellation usually costs a premium, but the Ear (1) brings it to a more accessible tier, putting pressure on established brands.

3. The case that gives back

Unlike typical earbud cases that only recharge the buds, this one doubles as a power bank, adding a second job to an accessory you already carry.

4. Reverse charging required

To use the case as a battery, your phone must support reverse charging. Without it, the feature is useless, so check your specs before buying.

5. Check your phone first

Does your phone support reverse charging? Look it up now. If not, this earbud case won't help you, and you'll need a different backup plan.
